en: The postcard displays a sepia-toned photograph of a beach scene taken from a shaded viewpoint under trees. In the foreground, a person is sitting on the sand looking towards the sea and a wooden pier. On the right, there is a horse and carriage. Hills and more trees are in the background. The front lower edge contains text in Cyrillic. The reverse side showcases handwritten text in Cyrillic (Bulgarian), postal markings, and a faded stamp.
